2026_ZH: Xeon 6+（Clearwater Forest）于 2026 年 6 月发布，计算芯粒用 18A。
2026_EN: Xeon 6+ (Clearwater Forest) launched in June 2026 with 18A compute chiplets.
Roadmap_ZH: Diamond Rapids 已披露 18A-P、最高 256 核及 Foveros Direct；本次一手资料未给明确上市日。14A 是后续平台。
Roadmap_EN: Diamond Rapids disclosures specify 18A-P, up to 256 cores and Foveros Direct; no firm launch date in the reviewed announcement. 14A is a subsequent platform.
Manufacturing_ZH: Intel 自有制造；18A 美国生产基础已建立。不能把所有裸片／封装默认分配至同一工厂。
Manufacturing_EN: Intel manufacturing; a US 18A production base exists. Do not assume every die and assembly step uses one facility.
Packaging_ZH: Clearwater 采用混合节点及 3D／桥接集成。Crescent Island 推理 GPU 披露最高 480GB LPDDR5X、350W 风冷方案：加速器并不全部采用 HBM。
Packaging_EN: Clearwater uses mixed nodes and 3D/bridge integration. The Crescent Island inference GPU specifies up to 480GB LPDDR5X and a 350W air-cooled design: not every accelerator uses HBM.

2026_ZH: 2026：Venice、MI400／MI455X 与 Helios。MI455X 规格列出 2nm／3nm 和 432GB HBM4。
2026_EN: 2026: Venice, MI400/MI455X and Helios. MI455X specifications list 2nm/3nm and 432GB HBM4.
Roadmap_ZH: 公司路线：2027 Verano + MI500；2028 Zen 7 Florence／Ferrara／Fidenza + MI600；2030 Zen 8 Ravenna。
Roadmap_EN: Company roadmap: Verano + MI500 in 2027; Zen 7 Florence/Ferrara/Fidenza + MI600 in 2028; Zen 8 Ravenna in 2030.
Manufacturing_ZH: Venice：TSMC 2nm 台湾爬坡已确认；未来 Arizona 计划未披露日期。后续各代节点及厂址不能由代号推定。
Manufacturing_EN: Venice: confirmed TSMC 2nm ramp in Taiwan; future Arizona ramp has no disclosed date. Later product names do not establish nodes or fab sites.
Packaging_ZH: CPU 与 GPU 分开判断。MI455X 多芯粒＋HBM4 带来高密度互连、供电、液冷及测试要求；三星 HBM4 合作不等于三星获得 GPU 逻辑代工。
Packaging_EN: Separate CPU from GPU requirements. MI455X chiplets and HBM4 require dense interconnect, power delivery, liquid cooling and testing. Samsung HBM4 collaboration is not a Samsung logic-foundry award.

2026_ZH: 2026 年 3 月推出 AGI CPU；9 月发布 Neoverse CSS N4。Arm 已不只是 IP 授权者。
2026_EN: AGI CPU introduced in March 2026; Neoverse CSS N4 announced in September. Arm now participates beyond IP licensing.
Roadmap_ZH: CSS 是客户设计基础，不是一款统一代工的 CPU。AGI 后续代际的具体节点、时间仍未完整公开。
Roadmap_EN: CSS is a customer-design foundation, not one universally manufactured CPU. Later AGI generations lack a complete public node and timing roadmap.
Manufacturing_ZH: AGI CPU：TSMC 3nm，两个相同裸片；未逐厂披露产量。Arm 授权本身不决定晶圆供应商。
Manufacturing_EN: AGI CPU: TSMC 3nm with two identical dies; fab-level volumes undisclosed. An Arm licence does not determine the foundry.
Packaging_ZH: AGI 用标准基板，官方强调无需特殊封装。不要把所有 Arm CPU 都计入 HBM／高级 3D 封装市场。
Packaging_EN: AGI uses a standard substrate; Arm says exotic packaging is unnecessary. Do not count every Arm CPU as HBM or advanced 3D packaging demand.

2026_ZH: 2026 年 4 月披露 TPU 8t（训练）与 8i（推理）；两者由 Axion CPU 承载。
2026_EN: TPU 8t for training and 8i for inference disclosed in April 2026, both hosted by Axion CPUs.
Roadmap_ZH: 已确认 Broadcom 长期参与未来 TPU 设计与供应；逐代上市日期与制程仍不完整。
Roadmap_EN: Broadcom is confirmed in a long-term future-TPU development and supply agreement; generation-by-generation launch dates and nodes remain incomplete.
Manufacturing_ZH: TPU 8t／8i 一手架构材料未指定 foundry、节点或具体厂址。TSMC 生态延续可作为待验证假设，不能写成已确认分配。
Manufacturing_EN: The reviewed TPU 8t/8i architecture disclosure does not name the foundry, node or fab. Continued TSMC ecosystem use is a hypothesis to validate, not a confirmed allocation.
Packaging_ZH: 8t：216GB HBM；8i：288GB。重点是 HBM 集成和多芯粒验证；Intel 已公开合作是 Xeon／IPU，并非 TPU 晶圆转单。
Packaging_EN: 8t: 216GB HBM; 8i: 288GB. HBM integration and chiplet qualification matter. Intel’s disclosed collaboration covers Xeon/IPUs, not a TPU wafer transfer.

2026_ZH: Graviton5 为 3nm 云端 CPU；Trainium3 已于 2025 年 12 月 GA，采用 3nm。
2026_EN: Graviton5 is a 3nm cloud CPU; 3nm Trainium3 became generally available in December 2025.
Roadmap_ZH: Trainium4 公司目标为 2027 年；后续制造节点与实际出货时间需要继续验证。
Roadmap_EN: Company target for Trainium4 is 2027; subsequent process details and shipment timing require verification.
Manufacturing_ZH: Trainium 历史上有官方 TSMC／CoWoS 合作。当前 SKU 的厂址未披露。Intel 合约是 18A AI fabric 与 Intel 3 定制 Xeon，不能改写为 Trainium 18A。
Manufacturing_EN: Official historical Trainium collaboration establishes TSMC/CoWoS use, not current SKU fab allocation. Intel’s announced work is an 18A AI fabric and Intel 3 custom Xeon, not an 18A Trainium.
Packaging_ZH: Trainium3：144GB HBM3e、4.9TB/s；Graviton 与 AI fabric 的封装价值和需求应分别建模。
Packaging_EN: Trainium3: 144GB HBM3e, 4.9TB/s. Model Graviton and AI-fabric packaging requirements separately.

2026_ZH: Cobalt 200：132 核、TSMC 3nm；Maia 200 于 2026 年 1 月发布，面向推理。
2026_EN: Cobalt 200: 132 cores, TSMC 3nm. Maia 200 announced in January 2026 for inference.
Roadmap_ZH: 下一代 Cobalt／Maia 的明确时间与制造分配尚未在所核实资料中公开。
Roadmap_EN: Firm next-generation Cobalt/Maia timing and manufacturing allocations are not public in the reviewed sources.
Manufacturing_ZH: Maia 200 为 TSMC 3nm。不要用微软与 Intel 的其他合作推断 Maia 已改用 18A。具体 fab 未披露。
Manufacturing_EN: Maia 200 uses TSMC 3nm. Other Microsoft–Intel relationships do not establish an 18A Maia transfer. Specific fabs are undisclosed.
Packaging_ZH: Maia：216GB HBM3e、7TB/s；优先评估下一代封装、I/O 芯粒及美国供应链认证。
Packaging_EN: Maia: 216GB HBM3e, 7TB/s. Assess next-generation packaging, I/O chiplets and US supply-chain qualification.

2026_ZH: Vera Rubin 于 2026 年宣布生产爬坡。Rubin 双计算裸片、288GB HBM4；Vera 为 Arm CPU。
2026_EN: Vera Rubin production ramp announced in 2026. Rubin has two compute dies and 288GB HBM4; Vera is an Arm CPU.
Roadmap_ZH: Rubin Ultra 的公司路线目标是 2027 年下半年。更远期平台不宜据传闻锁定 Intel 或任何具体 fab。
Roadmap_EN: Company roadmap targets Rubin Ultra systems in H2 2027. More distant platforms should not be assigned to Intel or a specific fab based on rumours.
Manufacturing_ZH: TSMC 先进制造生态是规划基线；本报告不把未逐 SKU 核实的节点、CoWoS 变体或台湾／美国份额作为确定值。
Manufacturing_EN: The TSMC manufacturing ecosystem is the planning baseline; node variants, CoWoS variants and Taiwan/US splits not verified per SKU are not treated as established facts.
Packaging_ZH: HBM4、裸片间带宽和机架液冷是约束。Vera 的 LPDDR5X 路线与 GPU HBM 封装不可混算。Intel 机会取决于下一代共同设计及资格认证。
Packaging_EN: HBM4, die-to-die bandwidth and rack liquid cooling constrain design. Vera’s LPDDR5X path differs from GPU HBM packaging. Intel access depends on future co-design and qualification.

2026_ZH: 2026 路线：MTIA 300 已生产；400 完成实验室测试，向部署推进。
2026_EN: 2026 roadmap: MTIA 300 in production; 400 completed lab testing and moving toward deployment.
Roadmap_ZH: MTIA 450 目标 2027 年初，500 目标 2027 年。Meta 亦为 Arm AGI CPU 首批核心合作方。
Roadmap_EN: MTIA 450 targeted for early 2027 and 500 for 2027. Meta is also a lead Arm AGI CPU partner.
Manufacturing_ZH: 最新 MTIA 公告未逐型号披露晶圆厂及节点；不能把其他公司的制造关系直接套用。
Manufacturing_EN: The latest MTIA announcement does not disclose foundries and nodes for each SKU; do not transplant another vendor’s manufacturing relationship.
Packaging_ZH: 模块化计算、内存与网络协同；快速迭代需要可复用的封装与验证流程，而非每代重新开展完整转厂。
Packaging_EN: Modular compute, memory and networking; fast iteration favours reusable packaging and qualification flows over repeated full foundry migrations.

Role_ZH: 定制芯片设计及交付渠道
2026_ZH: Broadcom 有 Google 长期协议与 3.5D 平台；Marvell 推进定制 HBM；Socionext 宣布采用 Intel 18A-P。
2026_EN: Broadcom has the Google agreement and a 3.5D platform; Marvell pursues custom HBM; Socionext announced Intel 18A-P development.
Roadmap_ZH: Socionext 首项开发为高性能计算芯粒。三者是通向云客户的渠道，并非可与终端客户需求重复相加的独立市场。
Roadmap_EN: Socionext’s first development is a high-performance compute chiplet. These firms are channels to cloud customers, not incremental markets to add to end-customer demand.
Manufacturing_ZH: Broadcom 公开 3.5D 平台基于 TSMC；Socionext 18A-P 是明确开发意向，但未披露量产收入或最终客户。
Manufacturing_EN: Broadcom’s disclosed 3.5D platform uses TSMC. Socionext’s 18A-P development is explicit, but production revenue and end customers are undisclosed.
Packaging_ZH: F2F 混合键合＋2.5D、HBM 逻辑底座、SerDes／I/O 共同设计。既可能成为 Intel 渠道，也拥有既定生态及议价权。
Packaging_EN: Face-to-face hybrid bonding plus 2.5D, HBM logic bases, SerDes and I/O co-design. Potential Intel channels also bring established ecosystems and bargaining power.

2026_ZH: MONAKA 为 2nm Arm CPU 项目；Ampere 已于 2025 年被 SoftBank 收购。
2026_EN: MONAKA is a 2nm Arm CPU programme; SoftBank completed its Ampere acquisition in 2025.
Roadmap_ZH: MONAKA 目标 2027；MONAKA-X 目标 2029。Ampere Aurora 宣布 512 核及 HBM 方向，未核实确定上市日。
Roadmap_EN: MONAKA targets 2027; MONAKA-X targets 2029. Ampere Aurora announced a 512-core/HBM direction without a verified firm launch date.
Manufacturing_ZH: MONAKA 明确由 TSMC 制造；MONAKA-X 考虑 Rapidus，尚未最终决定。不能写成日本 1.4nm 已获量产订单。
Manufacturing_EN: TSMC is confirmed for MONAKA; Rapidus is under consideration for MONAKA-X, not finally selected. This is not a confirmed Japanese 1.4nm production order.
Packaging_ZH: 区域供应链与 3D 芯粒是潜在入口；需证明足够产品数量及客户承诺，避免用国家级规划代替商业需求。
Packaging_EN: Regional supply chains and 3D chiplets offer possible entry points; require product volume and customer commitments rather than treating national plans as commercial demand.
